title: Terminal-Native Automated Test Suite Generation and Execution
oneLiner: OpenAI Codex CLI runs locally in the terminal to inspect source files, generate unit and integration tests, execute test runners, and iteratively fix failures in a sandboxed environment.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: OpenAI Codex CLI runs locally in the terminal to inspect source files, generate unit and integration tests, execute test runners, and iteratively fix failures in a sandboxed environment.
steps: Prompt test generation and approve sandboxed test execution.
configSnippet: "Generate pytest unit tests for src/billing.py covering edge cases, run the suite, and fix any failures."
limitations: Sandboxing behavior differs across macOS Seatbelt and Linux containers
